changes: No substantive changes. Expanded the notes on the marginal position, the garbled folio reference, and the catalogue fields that do not appear in the quoted text.

notes: The quoted text is only a Newari curse against theft, written in the right margin of fol. 26r: 'thva pustaka sunānaṃ robha pāpa yānā kāya madu, kāsā paṃca pāpa'. It means roughly 'nobody may take this book out of greed and so commit sin; whoever takes it incurs the five sins'. It names no person, date or place. The folio reference is garbled in the catalogue ('jālaṃdharaº' repeated, probably a running title or a slip in the database). The catalogue gives the scribe as Viśvaratna Vajrācārya and the place of copying as Kathmandu, but neither appears in this excerpt. They presumably come from a main colophon that was not quoted, so I did not extract them here.
